name: Naomi Nakamura
source:
The oldest of [url=https://vndb.org/c148177]Lin[/url]'s daughters, she gives the outward appearance of a cold and ruthless woman. Despite her constantly bickering with her sister [url=https://vndb.org/c148176]Hana[/url] she'd do just about anything for both her and [url=https://vndb.org/c148167]Emma[/url]. Growing up, [url=https://vndb.org/c148150]you[/url] looked up to Naomi as both of you practiced Judo together. She had a habit of scaring off any guy she showed interest in, but over time, the roles reversed, and she found herself scaring off guys who pursued her. Strangely, by then, she didn't seem all that interested in them anymore...
